text:
Maya: quick pass on the regression-diff view — a few UX/accessibility microcopy and layout asks before we freeze for the sprint.

Raj: thanks. can you enumerate? I skimmed earlier and had one thought about the bulk-approve CTA.

Maya: main things:
- visual diffs need a non-color-only affordance for "change" overlays (colorblind). propose hatch pattern + 2px outline
- approval CTA copy: 'Approve selected changes' vs 'Apply changes' — prefer explicit 'Approve' for clarity
- inline undo: show a toast with 'Undo' for 8s and link to activity log

Leah: +1 for hatch patterns. also the heatmap colors are < 4.5:1 on light backgrounds (esp. the orange). we should tweak to meet 4.5 contrast for text overlays

Tom: re: keyboard flow — when you arrow through diffs, focus should land on the diff container and a sr-only label should announce "Change #/total: summary". using `aria-live="polite"` for the summary update?

Eva: small copy nit: bulk modal header reads 'Approve changes' — change to 'Approve selected examples' to avoid implying global change

Maya: yesss. Also on compact rows: density is good but check hit targets — 44x44px min for approval checkbox + kebab. current is ~36px

Raj: design-bot posted a quick prototype: https://figma.com/file/abc123/diff-proto — has hatch + keyboard states. @Leah can we get color tokens updated?

Leah: will send updated tokens today. Also adding pattern fallback for svg for older browsers.

Maya: microcopy for undo toast suggestion:
"Approved 12 examples. Undo" (button) — and under the hood it should open the approval activity pane scrolled to these items.

Tom: accessibility checklist to add to PR:
- focus ring visible at 3px contrast
- aria-live for diff count
- accessible name for approve button = "Approve selected examples (12)"

Eva: one more: confirmation modal should be dismissible with Esc and have role=dialog + aria-modal

Maya: thanks all — I'll update the ticket with copy and attach screenshots. if no objections I'll merge these as a patch in the next minor release :thumbsup:

design-bot: prototype snapshot posted (v2) :camera:
